guard: The mesh handler's wait(replied) observer is real: the descriptor routes to the turn-terminal machinery, an unobservable handle refuses on the roster, only a succeeded terminal is a reply, two replies resolve to the latest by the yield's own stamp, the mediated timeout is armed and claimed, and the turn-goal registry is fed at submission and reseeded at adoption
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/mesh-replied.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: Lane F durable-actions step 7 (2026-09-02): `wait(replied)` leaves the not-yet-durable seam
and observes the run's own turn terminals as a LEVEL, `down`'s shape. Each obligation has a
mutant: the routing that sends a replied descriptor to this machinery instead of the channel
path (R1), the roster refusal that keeps an unobservable handle from parking on nothing (R2),
the succeeded-only filter that keeps a deadline deny from reading as a reply (R3), the
latest-wins selection (R4), the mediated timeout's arm (R5) and the claim on resolution (R6),
and the registry the observation rides: fed by `turn` at submission (R7) and reseeded from
the journal at adoption (R8). All eight mutate mesh-handler.ts, which the suite imports
through a relative `../src` path — no build sits between the mutation and the run.

mutations.name: a replied descriptor is routed to the channel machinery
mutations.find: if (ev.event === "replied") return await this.waitReplied(ev, req, ctx);
mutations.replace: if (false) return await this.waitReplied(ev, req, ctx);
mutations.note: The branch gone, a replied descriptor falls into the channel path and dies reading a channel it does not have. Measured 2026-09-02: fifteen reds — every block, the suite reaching its own exit; 0 passed, 15 failed.

mutations.name: the roster refusal is dropped, so an unobservable handle parks on nothing
mutations.expectRed: wait(replied) on an unknown handle refuses naming the roster
mutations.cell: wait(replied) on an unknown handle refuses naming the roster
mutations.note: Only this run's turns are observable, so a stranger's handle can never resolve; unrefused, it parks silently to the block's bounded deadline. Measured 2026-09-02: two reds — the bounded deadline and the named cell; 14 passed, 2 failed.

mutations.name: a denied terminal is read as a reply
mutations.expectRed: the denied turn never resolves the wait: the timeout resolves null, never a throw
mutations.cell: the denied turn never resolves the wait: the timeout resolves null, never a throw
mutations.note: A deadline deny means the agent never finished a reply; read as one, its reason-shaped data fails the shape check and the wait throws where the contract promises a timeout null. Measured 2026-09-02: two reds — the null cell and the expired-settle cell behind it; 13 passed, 2 failed.

mutations.name: the latest-wins selection collapses to first-seen
mutations.expectRed: a wait over two completed turns resolves to the later yield
mutations.cell: a wait over two completed turns resolves to the later yield
mutations.note: The level's whole answer to "which reply" is the yield's own stamp; collapsed, registry insertion order decides instead. Measured 2026-09-02: exactly one named red (the value reads "first"); 14 passed, 1 failed.

mutations.name: the timeout is never armed, so no deadline exists on the plane
mutations.find:
if (primary !== undefined) await this.arm(primary, this.now() + parseDuration(req.timeout!));
    const actx = await this.actionCtx();
mutations.replace:
if (false) await this.arm(primary!, this.now() + parseDuration(req.timeout!));
    const actx = await this.actionCtx();
mutations.expectRed: the timeout pause settled expired on the plane
mutations.cell: the timeout pause settled expired on the plane
mutations.note: With no mint there is nothing to expire or claim: the unanswered wait parks to its bounded deadline and every settle read is empty. Measured 2026-09-02: five reds across the timeout, level-claim and cancellation cells; 11 passed, 5 failed.

mutations.name: a resolution leaves the armed pause live
mutations.expectRed: the resolution claims the armed pause: no timer fires into a run that moved on
mutations.cell: the resolution claims the armed pause: no timer fires into a run that moved on
mutations.note: A resolved wait that forgets its pause leaves a deadline armed to fire into a run that moved on. Measured 2026-09-02: exactly one named red; 14 passed, 1 failed.

mutations.name: turn never feeds the registry the observation rides
mutations.expectRed: the settled wait records the reply as the observation value: the handle, the yield, its stamp
mutations.cell: the settled wait records the reply as the observation value: the handle, the yield, its stamp
mutations.note: The registry IS the observable: unfed, every live-path wait parks forever while its turn completes unseen. Measured 2026-09-02: ten reds across the driven, parked and level blocks; 8 passed, 10 failed.

mutations.name: adoption reseeds nothing, so a resumed run cannot re-observe
mutations.expectRed: the adopted handler re-observes the recorded reply at once
mutations.cell: the adopted handler re-observes the recorded reply at once
mutations.note: The registry is deterministic from the journal alone; unseeded, an adopted run parks on a reply its own journal records. Measured 2026-09-02: three reds — the bounded deadline and both adoption cells; 13 passed, 3 failed.
